description: Our team is currently composed of 3 members, and we are really looking forward to finding other people who want to join us on this incredible journey. We want to combine our interest in physics and astrophysics with artificial intelligence and coding to achieve the goal of the challenge.
summary:
SES is an interactive web application that explores connections between Earth and potential landing sites on the Moon and Mars. Using 3D planetary models, users can select a lunar or Martian destination and discover terrestrial locations with comparable physical characteristics, such as terrain relief, slope, geology or temperature.

The workspace displays the selected locations side by side, highlighting their shared features and providing access to the data behind each comparison. A research archive organizes the available information into categories, while ragAI helps users explore related questions using online sources.

Developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, SES makes planetary analog research more accessible and encourages users to see familiar landscapes from a new perspective. Its comparisons are exploratory starting points for further scientific investigation.
